$comment: Список промптов для gen.mjs / post.mjs. Поля item: id (имя файла), group (для --group), prompt, size (размер запроса к API), background ('transparent' | 'opaque'), target {w,h} (размер после даунскейла), colors (число цветов при квантовании), crop (необязательно: 'cover' — обрезать до пропорций target перед даунскейлом), kernel ('nearest' | 'lanczos3'). Поля из defaults применяются ко всем item, у которых они не заданы.

defaults.stylePrefix: Pixel art for a 2D side-scrolling platformer, strict 16x16 pixel grid where every 'pixel' is a crisp uniform square block, flat colors, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no lighting effects, limited palette of 16 colors, 1-pixel dark outline, side view (orthographic, no perspective), no text, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no drop shadow.
defaults.styleSuffix: Dark comedic urban style of a game about rats living in a backyard dump and sneaking into a kitchen.

items.prompt: A tileset sheet for a KITCHEN level, laid out on a regular grid of 16 columns by 16 rows of equal square tiles, each tile isolated with transparent gaps between them. Contents, left-to-right, top-to-bottom: checkered beige-and-brown floor tiles with left/middle/right edge variants; pale tiled wall tiles with a grout line; a wooden kitchen counter top (platform) with left/middle/right pieces; lower cabinets with doors and handles; upper cabinets; a white gas stove with four burners and an oven door; a tall white refrigerator split into 2x3 tiles; a steel sink with a tap; a shelf with jars; a wooden table edge; a baseboard tile; a vent grille; a door frame; a window with night sky. Palette: cream, beige, light brown, dark brown, steel grey, white, teal accents, black outline.

A single inventory icon of a rat's slimy green secretion: one glossy teardrop-shaped blob of toxic green goo with a single white highlight pixel, centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, isolated on a transparent background. Palette: 3 shades of acid green plus black outline and one white highlight.

A single inventory icon of a flat puddle of rat secretion: a wide, low oval splat of dark green slime with two small satellite drops, viewed from slightly above, centered, isolated on a transparent background. Palette: 3 shades of swamp green plus black outline.

A single inventory icon of a brown rat dropping: a small dark brown pellet pile of three elongated pellets with tiny green stink wisps above, centered, isolated on a transparent background. Palette: 2 shades of dark brown, 1 pale green, black outline.

A single sprite frame of a grey street rat, side view facing RIGHT, in a crouched take-off pose: hind legs bent and compressed, body coiled low, head slightly raised, tail curled behind, ready to leap. Fits a 32x32 pixel sprite box, rat body about 24 pixels wide and 12 pixels tall, isolated on a transparent background. Palette: 3 shades of grey fur, pink ears/nose/tail, a black eye, black outline.

A single sprite frame of a grey street rat, side view facing RIGHT, in mid-air leap: body fully stretched horizontally, front paws extended forward, hind legs extended back, tail straight out behind, belly visible. Same character as a crouching take-off frame: 3 shades of grey fur, pink ears/nose/tail, a black eye, black outline. Fits a 32x32 pixel sprite box, isolated on a transparent background.

A single sprite frame of a chubby adult human in a stained white apron (a cook), side view facing LEFT, PANICKING: both arms thrown straight up, mouth wide open, eyes as big white circles, knees bent mid-run, one foot forward. Fits a 32x48 pixel sprite box, isolated on a transparent background. Palette: skin tone, white apron, dark blue trousers, brown hair, black outline, red mouth.

A single sprite frame of a chubby adult human cook in a stained white apron, side view facing LEFT, PANICKING, running frame two: arms up and bent at the elbows waving, legs crossed mid-stride, hair standing up, three sweat drops flying off the head. Same character design as other frames: skin tone, white apron, dark blue trousers, brown hair, black outline. Fits a 32x48 pixel sprite box, isolated on a transparent background.

A single sprite frame of a chubby adult human cook in a stained white apron, side view facing LEFT, PANICKING, running frame three: body leaning forward, arms flung back, long stride with both feet off the ground, mouth open screaming. Same character design as other frames: skin tone, white apron, dark blue trousers, brown hair, black outline. Fits a 32x48 pixel sprite box, isolated on a transparent background.

Parallax background layer, FAR plane, for a BACKYARD DUMP level: a dusky evening sky with a few flat clouds and a low orange glow at the horizon, a silhouette skyline of five-storey Soviet panel apartment blocks with small lit windows, a distant water tower. Horizontally tileable (left and right edges match seamlessly). Wide 16:9 composition, no foreground objects, opaque background. Palette: muted purple-grey sky, dark blue-grey buildings, warm yellow window lights, 16 colors total.

Parallax background layer, MIDDLE plane, for a BACKYARD DUMP level: a long grey concrete fence with graffiti, a leafless tree, a rusty metal garage, a street lamp with a cone of light, a row of overflowing green dumpsters and black trash bags at the base. Everything sits on a ground line in the bottom 20% of the image; the upper area is fully TRANSPARENT so a sky layer shows through. Horizontally tileable. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: grey concrete, rust brown, dull green, dark grey, 16 colors total.

Parallax background layer, NEAR plane, for a BACKYARD DUMP level: sparse foreground details only - tufts of dry grass, a broken bottle, a crumpled newspaper, a puddle, a cardboard box, a bent bicycle wheel, all along the bottom 15% of the image; everything above is fully TRANSPARENT. Horizontally tileable. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: dark grey, brown, dirty yellow, 12 colors total.

Parallax background layer, FAR plane, for a canteen KITCHEN level seen from rat height (camera low at floor level looking at the back wall): ONLY the far back wall, nothing else - a pale cream ceramic tiled wall with a grout grid and grease stains, a dark window with night outside, a row of dim fluorescent tube lights under the ceiling giving a cold greenish-white light, a wall clock, a greasy ventilation hood. NO floor, NO ground line, no counters, no foreground objects: the wall fills the whole image from top to bottom. Opaque. Horizontally tileable: the left and right edges must match seamlessly, the tile grid continues across the edge. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: cream, beige, light brown grout, dark blue window, pale green-white fluorescent glow, 16 colors total.

Parallax background layer, MIDDLE plane, for a canteen KITCHEN level seen from rat height: a continuous row of stainless steel counters and work tables with cabinets underneath, a tall white industrial fridge, a steel sink, a gas stove, pots and ladles hanging from a rail above the counters, a red fire extinguisher. All of this occupies ONLY the bottom 35% of the image as one continuous horizontal strip standing on a floor line at the very bottom edge; everything above the hanging pots (the upper 65% of the image) is fully TRANSPARENT. Horizontally tileable: the counter row continues seamlessly across the left and right edges (no end pieces at the sides). Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: steel grey, white, light brown wood, red extinguisher, dark grey, 16 colors total. Keep the outer 5% at both the left and right edges free of large objects (plain counter and wall only) so the image wraps seamlessly.

Parallax background layer, NEAR plane, for a canteen KITCHEN level seen from rat height: a ground-level strip ONLY along the bottom 25% of the image - the edge of a checkered beige-and-brown tiled floor with a dark baseboard, a mop in a bucket, a crumpled paper bag, a dropped fork, bread crumbs, a cockroach, a puddle of dishwater; everything above the bottom 25% is fully TRANSPARENT. Horizontally tileable: the floor strip continues seamlessly across the left and right edges. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: beige, brown, grey, steel, 12 colors total. Keep the outer 5% at both the left and right edges free of objects (plain floor tiles and baseboard only, at the same height on both sides) so the image wraps seamlessly.

Parallax background layer, FAR plane, for a ROOFTOP level at night: ONLY sky and a distant city skyline, no ground, no rooftops, no foreground objects - a night sky in flat bands of deep navy blue, violet and a thin orange-pink glow at the horizon, a few stars, a crescent moon, a flat silhouette skyline of distant apartment blocks, a TV tower and a factory chimney with tiny lit windows, the skyline silhouette being a thin band in the bottom 20% of the image. Opaque. Horizontally tileable: the left and right edges match seamlessly. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: navy, violet, orange glow, dark slate silhouettes, warm yellow windows, 16 colors total.

Parallax background layer, MIDDLE plane, for a ROOFTOP level at night: the tops of neighbouring rooftops as one continuous horizontal strip in the bottom 35% of the image - tar paper roofs, brick chimneys, ventilation pipes, TV antennas, a satellite dish, a water tank, a clothes line with laundry; everything above the chimneys and antennas (the upper 65%) is fully TRANSPARENT. Horizontally tileable: the row of rooftops continues seamlessly across the left and right edges (no end walls at the sides). Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: dark grey, brick red, rust, dull white laundry, 16 colors total. Keep the outer 5% at both the left and right edges free of objects (plain flat roof parapet only, at the same height on both sides) so the image wraps seamlessly.

Parallax background layer, NEAR plane, for a ROOFTOP level at night: a ground-level strip ONLY along the bottom 25% of the image - a flat roof surface of grey gravel and black tar paper with patched seams, a low rusty railing segment, a roof edge with a gutter, a few pigeon feathers, a puddle; everything above the bottom 25% is fully TRANSPARENT. Horizontally tileable: the roof strip continues seamlessly across the left and right edges. Wide 16:9 composition. Palette: dark slate, grey gravel, rust, black tar, 12 colors total. Keep the outer 5% at both the left and right edges free of objects (plain gravel and railing only, at the same height on both sides) so the image wraps seamlessly.
